internal_discovery.plain_explanation: When Twf appears as a verb or a moving-agent participle, it means to go around, circulate, or move about among/around something — pilgrims circling the House, youths circulating drink among reclining people, vessels being passed round, the damned driven back and forth between fire and scalding water, a calamity sweeping round a garden. It never means walking straight toward a goal. But the common noun TaA^}ifa ('a party / portion of a group') and the noun TuwfaAn ('the flood/plague') do not carry this going-around meaning at all; they are separate fixed words that only happen to share the root, so the root is not one single meaning.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Twf does NOT entail: (1) linear/directed travel toward a destination (contrast atA/jA'a/dakhala/sAr) — its motion is round/among/oscillating (55:44 bayna…wa-bayna); (2) sacredness or ritual — the motion sense covers paradise service (37:45; 52:24; 76:19), Hell (55:44), a Satanic impulse (7:201), a garden calamity (68:19); circumambulation of the Kaaba (22:29; 2:158; 22:26; 2:125) is a contextual specialization, not the root meaning; (3) benefit/harm valence — honoured service, passive circulation of cups, and destructive visitation all share it; (4) for TaA^}ifa: any physical motion, any fixed size, or any moral valence — it is purely partitive (min-marked), applied alike to believers (24:2; 73:20), People of the Book (3:69; 3:72), hypocrites (4:81; 4:113), the oppressed (28:4), and the enemy (8:7); (5) for TuwfaAn: 'water' as such — the root there contributes only 'overwhelming, all-encompassing calamity sent upon' (7:133 lists it among five plagues), and the verb TaAfa is never applied to it.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 6:156:7:1 'innamA unzila l-kitAbu 'alA TaA^}ifatayni min qablinA' — 'two [scripture-receiving] communities before us': a purely enumerated pair with zero motion, circuit, or encircling content. These prove that no single 'going-around' meaning can cover the corpus: the dominant TaA^}ifa class belongs to the faction/portion field, not the motion field.

internal_discovery.rationale: Three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B bridging-test, adversary C) converge on the same structure. The motion nucleus (Cluster MOTION_CIRCUIT, 15 occ) is broad, distinctive, government-consistent, and adversarially clean within its derivational family: every member is roundabout/among/oscillating motion, never goal-travel, and 68:19 supplies an in-verse bridge (faTAfa 'alayhA TaA^}if) tying the agent-noun to the verb. Distinctiveness is Quran-internal: 2:125 / 22:26 set al-TaA^}ifiyn (moving round) against al-'AkifIn / al-rukka' al-sujUd (staying/fixed postures), isolating the motion feature. However, TaA^}ifa (Cluster TAIFA_PARTITIVE, 24/41 ≈ 59%) is a coherent lexicalized nominal sub-class that does NOT carry the motion sense in a single occurrence — its live feature is partitivity (a proper subset of a named whole), field-synonymous with firqa/farIq (9:122; 33:13) and opposed to kAffa (9:122). Leaning on the morphological derivation (TaA^}ifa = fem. active participle of TAfa) to force unity would violate the contract (morphology ≠ semantic identity). TuwfaAn (Cluster TUFAN_CALAMITY, 2 occ) is a second lexicalized residue whose bridge to the motion nucleus is asserted only externally and is Quran-internally UNRESOLVED. Per the contract, a resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE. The claim is therefore made honestly as REPRESENTATIVE of the verbal–participial derivational family, with explicit carve-outs for TaA^}ifa and TuwfaAn, rather than forced into one universal nucleus.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses converged: Analyst A (bottom-up form/government), Analyst B (bridging-test), Adversary C (adversarial refutation). All three independently isolated the same motion nucleus, the same resistant TaA^}ifa class, and the same TuwfaAn residue, and all three proposed MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE with a multi-class structural verdict.
candidate_root_contribution: To move in an encircling / roundabout circuit — going round, about, or among a reference point or set — as opposed to linear goal-directed travel toward a destination. Case-government is internally regular: bi- = go round an axis/locus (22:29 bi-l-Bayt; 2:158 bi-himā), 'alā = circulate round/upon/among (52:24; 56:17; 76:19; 68:19), yuTaAfu bi- = be passed round / circulated with vessels (37:45; 43:71; 76:15), bayna…wa-bayna = driven to-and-fro between two poles (55:44). The sense includes the agentive nominal 'an encompassing visitation that comes round upon one' (68:19 TaA^}if min rabbik, bridged in-verse to the verb TaAfa). This account governs the verbal–participial derivational family (Form I TaAfa/yaTuwfu/yuTaAfu, Form V yaT~aw~afa, participles TaA^}if / TaA^}ifiyn, intensive Taw~a`f). It does NOT extend to the lexicalized nominal TaA^}ifa 'a portion/faction' (a partitive subset of a whole, carrying zero motion) nor to the lexicalized TuwfaAn 'overwhelming calamity/deluge'.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: The 41 occurrences split behaviourally: 15 show roundabout/among/oscillating motion with regular bi-/'alA/bayna government (verbs, TaA^}ifiyn, Taw~a`f, TaA^}if); 24 show a min-partitive/dual-enumerated 'portion/faction' with stative, speech, belief, or verdict predicates and no circuit; 2 (TuwfaAn) show a frozen calamity 'seized/sent upon'.
layer_attribution.derivation: Form I (TAfa/yaTuwfu/yuTaAfu), Form V (yaT~aw~afa), active participles (TaA^}if/TaA^}ifiyn), intensive fa''Al (Taw~a`f) all realize the motion nucleus; TaA^}ifa is morphologically the fem. active participle of TAfa and TuwfaAn a fu'lAn nominal, but derivation is NOT used as semantic authority (contract: morphology ≠ semantic identity).
layer_attribution.lexical_class: TaA^}ifa is a lexicalized partitive count-noun ('a portion/faction', field-synonymous with firqa/farIq, opposed to kAffa) that has shed the motion component; TuwfaAn is a lexicalized calamity-noun ('overwhelming deluge/plague'). Both are distinct lexemes sharing only the root.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Circumambulation of the Kaaba (22:29; 2:158; 22:26; 2:125), paradise service (37:45; 52:24; 76:19), Hell's to-and-fro (55:44), a Satanic prompting (7:201), and a garden calamity (68:19) are contextual specializations of the one motion nucleus; none of these narrative/contextual senses is promoted to the root claim, which stays at 'roundabout/among/encircling motion'.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Two within-nucleus tensions resolved: 7:201 (preliminary RESISTANT as bleached 'touch') kept CONSISTENT as the agentive 'encompassing visitation' via its in-verse parallel 68:19; 55:44 (candidate counterexample to single-axis orbit) kept CONSISTENT after broadening the account to 'roundabout/oscillating' per its bayna…wa-bayna government.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: TaA^}ifa (24/41) is a coherent lexicalized nominal sub-class that resists the motion nucleus in every occurrence — the principal resistance capping the grade at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE; TuwfaAn (2/41) is an unbridged lexicalized residue whose internal link to the motion nucleus remains UNRESOLVED.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The root is genuinely multi-class. The motion nucleus holds cleanly over its derivational family (15 occ), but a large coherent lexicalized nominal sub-class — TaA^}ifa 'portion/faction' (24 occ, ~59%) — persistently resists the motion account in every occurrence, and TuwfaAn (2 occ) is an unbridged lexicalized residue. All 24 resistant TaA^}ifa occurrences are recorded as RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases and listed in counterevidence_refs; the two TuwfaAn residues are recorded as STRUCTURAL_ATYPICALITY and in counterevidence_refs; 7:201 and 55:44 are adversarial boundaries within the motion nucleus.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A verbal or moving-agent occurrence of Twf (TAfa/yaTuwfu/yuTaAfu/yaT~aw~afa/TaA^}if/TaA^}ifiyn/Taw~a`f) that denotes linear goal-directed travel toward a destination (behaving like atA/dakhala/sAr) rather than roundabout/among/oscillating motion; OR any TaA^}ifa occurrence that demonstrably activates live circling/going-round motion of the group itself. Either finding would break the partition between the motion nucleus and the TaA^}ifa lexicalized class.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 15 MOTION_CIRCUIT occurrences (test their case-government: bi-/'alA/bayna) and, adversarially, the 24 TAIFA_PARTITIVE occurrences (test whether any predicate is one of circling rather than saying/believing/standing/fighting/being pardoned).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each occurrence's governing preposition and main predicate from verse_text: confirm motion members take bi-/'alA/bayna with a circuit/among reading, and confirm TaA^}ifa members are min-partitive or dual-enumerated with stative/speech/belief predicates and no circuit verb.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not treat the morphological derivation (TaA^}ifa as fem. active participle of TAfa) as semantic identity; do not read the Kaaba ritual context (22:29; 2:158; 22:26; 2:125) as the root meaning; do not import external etymology ('encircling water') into TuwfaAn.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a TaA^}ifa shows live circling, the two-class partition collapses toward a single nucleus and REPRESENTATIVE/DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY must be revisited (possibly broadened); if a motion member shows goal-directed travel, the narrow 'roundabout, not linear' account fails and the nucleus must be re-specified or downgraded toward UNRESOLVED.

reopen_conditions: If a future analysis demonstrates a Quran-internal bridge whereby a TaA^}ifa occurrence (e.g. 9:122 min kulli firqatin minhum TaA^}ifa, or the duals 49:9/8:7/6:156) carries live circling/going-round motion of the group itself, reopen the TaA^}ifa-vs-motion partition and reconsider merging TAIFA_PARTITIVE into the nucleus.

If TuwfaAn (29:14, 7:133) is shown Quran-internally to derive its sense from the encircling/encompassing motion of TAfa (rather than 'an overwhelming calamity seized/sent upon'), reopen the TUFAN_CALAMITY classification and the outer boundary of the motion nucleus.

If 7:201 TaA^}if min al-shayTAn (paired with massahum) is shown to be a distinct 'touch/impulse' lexeme not reducible to the encircling-visitation sense evidenced at 68:19, reopen the membership of the singular TaA^}if in MOTION_CIRCUIT.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A formal adversarial falsification returning SUPPORTED-with-no-failing-occurrences was not run to PASSED because the root is multi-class: the motion nucleus is adversarially clean within its own derivational family (no member denotes linear goal-travel; distinctiveness from 'Akafa/qAma/rukU'/sujUd shown at 2:125/22:26, and TaA^}ifa's group-sense shown to belong to the firqa/farIq field at 9:122/33:13), but a coherent lexicalized nominal class (TaA^}ifa, 24 occ) resists a unified account and TuwfaAn (2 occ) is unbridged. Per contract, when the core holds but occurrences resist, status is NOT_RUN with resistance recorded — not PASSED (no clean whole-root refutation) and not FAILED (the scoped motion claim is not refuted).
